svg.title: Knapsack dynamic programming table
svg.desc: The 0/1 knapsack table for capacity 5 and items (2, $12), (1, $10), (3, $20), (2, $15) fills cell by cell to $37, then a traceback recovers items 1, 2 and 4.
svg.text: Knapsack: fill the table once, never recompute
F(1,1): item 1 (weight 2) does not fit → F(0,1) = 0
F(3,1): item 3 (weight 3) does not fit → F(2,1) = 10
F(3,2): item 3 (weight 3) does not fit → F(2,2) = 12
F(4,1): item 4 (weight 2) does not fit → F(3,1) = 10
F(3,3) = 22 = F(2,3) → item 3 is not needed; stay at j = 3
F(i, j) = max( F(i−1, j), vᵢ + F(i−1, j − wᵢ) ) if j ≥ wᵢ, else F(i−1, j)
